description: This file defines the 'Antispam' controller class for the OpenCart admin CMS module. It contains methods for handling anti-spam rules, including listing, adding, editing, and deleting spam keywords or rules. The class extends a system engine controller and interacts with models, views, and the request/response systems to manage anti-spam configurations within the admin interface.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Controller class for managing Anti-Spam rules within the OpenCart admin CMS section. Handles listing, form display, saving, and deletion of spam keyword rules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the list of anti-spam rules and renders the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of anti-spam entries by retrieving data and passing to the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns HTML for the anti-spam list, including pagination, filtering, and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an anti-spam rule.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission for creating or updating an anti-spam rule. Returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected anti-spam rules based on user permissions, responds with JSON indicating success or errors.
